reuse.why: Ignores the exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which already computes exactly this for forecasts, posting and templates, and writes a private replacement.

duplication.why: expectedScheduleAmount duplicates getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range dispatch, and even diverges on ties (> instead of >=) and null handling.

placement.why: Putting the field in scheduleModel.toExternal is right, but the amount rule is defined in api-models.ts instead of the shared schedules module where the tree keeps it.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and a new test file change.

maintainability.why: A second, subtly different definition of the expected amount means the API can disagree with what Actual actually posts when the rule changes.

disguised_duplication.where: expectedScheduleAmount in api-models.ts is getScheduledAmount renamed and reshaped (undefined check, strict > comparison, no inverse option).
